== Summary ==
Players Committee photograph from the DecipherCon 2002 picture gallery.

Gallery caption: "World Champion Angelo Consoli (Germany/Italy) and Runner-Up Greg Shaw (New Jersey) play an extremely close final (1 differential) until 5:30am Sunday."
